# Iteration 13 one-off migration: backfilled headlines for 9 legacy
# 2-column entries (runs 17-25) using the loop log as source of truth.
# Before this migration, semantic dedup only worked for new entries

# entries — surfaced by run 29 when the pipeline selected
# "Gilgo Beach suspect pleads guilty..." even though run 17 had
# already selected "Rex Heuermann Pleads Guilty to Gilgo Beach Serial
# Killings" (same event, same person). With the backfilled headlines,
# proper-noun overlap on {gilgo, beach} now correctly dedups them.
